acceptance_criteria: all expected tests executed, no skip/failure/error
all valid production metrics exactly match independent integer oracle
uniform fixtures also match existing F60 exact MSE/support
all invalid cases rejected with preregistered codes
forbidden modules never loaded and Controller invocations0
full F64 PASS forbidden while r_budget unresolved

accepted_dtypes.numerators: list[exact Python int, not bool]; abs(value)<=denominator
accepted_dtypes.times_ns: list[exact Python int, not bool]; nonnegative int64

boundary_inclusion_rules: Source numerical domain and max_gap inclusive; exact RMS comparator squares nonnegative threshold and compares rational MSE; no epsilon.
canonicalization: UTF-8 ASCII subset; sorted keys; separators comma/colon; ensure_ascii=true; allow_nan=false; exactly one LF; input bytes must already equal canonical encoding; duplicate JSON keys rejected; arrays never sorted.

deterministic_seed_policy.algorithm: SHA256 counter expansion for bounded noise; integer modulo; no statistical/cryptographic performance claims
deterministic_seed_policy.encoding: ASCII domain + uint64 seed big-endian8 + uint64 sample index big-endian8; digest first4 bytes big endian modulo(2*amplitude+1) minus amplitude

f60_production_dependency.adoption: Exact-byte copy in isolated branch only; original untracked file untouched. Call only attribute_samples on public uniform fixtures; never main/analyze_f10_pair/log loader. Pure numeric compatibility, no source/admissibility upgrade.

generator.irregular_dt: half or full nominal dt, according to(seed+i)%2; explicit new synthetic sampling extension not F60 grid compatibility

holdout_execution_policy: One preregistered adjudication cohort: two independent fresh output directories, each one execution of generated fixtures/metrics. Both reproductions finish before result inspection; one combined immutable verdict. No retries or post-inspection code/criteria change. Two passes satisfy reproducibility; not two adaptive holdout selections.

holdout_seed_derivation_policy.input: ASCII domain + lowercase40-hex PRE_HOLDOUT_COMMIT_SHA; no newline
holdout_seed_derivation_policy.seeds: digest bytes0:8 and8:16 interpreted unsigned big-endian integers

isolation: AST project import graph and allowed module roots; dynamic import finder plus builtins import guard and Python audit hooks: subprocess/fork/exec/system, sockets, ctypes.dlopen, private/log paths blocked. Existing controllers must not be loaded before entry. Not an OS security sandbox against arbitrary hostile Python.

metric_definitions.abs_rate_p95: linear quantile h=(M-1)*95/100 of sorted absolute adjacent rates; exact rational interpolation
metric_definitions.initial: No prepended0, matches F60/F62 N-1 support, not F10 prepend0/N convention
metric_definitions.mean_square_rate: sum(rate_i^2)/(N-1), equal pair weighting even for irregular sampling
metric_definitions.missing: No missing permitted; nonfinite/invalid schema rejected
metric_definitions.rate_rms: exact algebraic sqrt(mean_square_rate), represented by rational radicand; no rounded float metric stored
metric_definitions.single_sample: all pair metrics null; diagnostic INSUFFICIENT_PAIRS
metric_definitions.unsupported_metrics: Curvature/position/heading/vehicle dynamics excluded: no independent trajectory/reference contract in this generic waveform source.

normalization: None: preserve start timestamp; generated default start0; derivative uses exact differences.
ordering_policy: preserve original array order; do not sort timestamps

r_budget.prohibited: No p95/max backfit, no trivial normalized-domain bound relabeled as approved budget.

r_definition.evidence: F61 defines rate_budget_per_s only as a caller-declared synthetic constraint, not a repository-wide justified prospective r or approved budget.

shape: Equal-length times_ns/numerators arrays;1..8000 samples. 8000 inherited descriptive F10 horizon, not physical limit.

diagnostic_rate_comparator.meaning: unit calibration boundary BELOW/EQUAL/ABOVE only; not r, acceptance budget, vehicle limit or candidate gate

oracle_difference.meaning: exact rational equality, structural correctness only

time_basis: Existing F10 time_ns=n*10000000 and F60 TIME_NS=10000000; no sensor/acquisition semantics.

time_conversion.input: exact nonnegative int only; reject all floats including1.0/NaN/Inf
time_conversion.overflow: reject outside nonnegative signed-int64 before/after multiplication; intervals computed with unbounded integer then checked
time_conversion.round_trip: inverse only if canonical_ns divisible by unit multiplier; otherwise F64_TIME_NONINTEGRAL
